description: Bengal Hydro Detective pairs a 24-year NASA Earth observation pipeline (2002–2026) with an offline web workbench to track water storage trends across Bangladesh. It helps students, researchers, and water planners inspect significant storage decline across regions home to 108.5 million residents (-1.25 cm/yr in the Northwest) while separating long-term drawdown from short-window variability and spurious reanalysis rainfall trends.
